source: Adapted cross-reference, September 2026: en.wikipedia's history and line-ups table, and view counts read from YouTube on 2026-09-14 from a search for 'glastonbury full set pyramid stage', filtered to official channels (BBC Music, which broadcasts the festival, and the artists' own). This site's catalogue (source 6 of FIGURES.md) holds no Glastonbury set. Every player is oEmbed-checked 14 September 2026.

required_records.title: Breathe
required_records.why: about 3.8 million views on BBC Music's channel (2026-09-14); The Prodigy headlined in 1997; evidence for dance music at the festival in the music section

required_records.title: Fix You
required_records.why: the most watched Glastonbury upload found, about 67 million views on BBC Music's channel (2026-09-14); Coldplay hold the record of five headline sets, the fifth in 2024; Essential listening
